title: Write src/farewell.txt
body:
## Goal
Create `src/farewell.txt` containing the single line `goodbye after iteration 11`. Create only this file.
Iteration 11 is the iteration in which `src/greeting.txt` was merged (its record `iterations/0011.json` lists task `write-greeting`).

## Acceptance
- [ ] `src/farewell.txt` contains exactly `goodbye after iteration 11` followed by a newline
- [ ] no other file is created or changed

## Verification
`python3 -c "import sys; sys.exit(open('src/farewell.txt').read() != 'goodbye after iteration 11\n')"`

## Context
- link: iterations/0011.json, the record that shows the greeting merge in iteration 11
- link: src/greeting.txt, existing file, do not change it

## Budget
- iterations/0011.json
- src/greeting.txt
- src/farewell.txt
